💌 A letter from Drew

Happy 2nd Anniversary, My Love

Drew & Frinzez · Two Years · 730 Days of Choosing Each Other

Two years.

Twenty-four months.

Seven hundred and thirty days.

If someone were to ask me what these last two years have been like, I don't think I could answer them in a single sentence.

Because our story was never just a story of love.

It was a story of choosing.

Choosing each other when things were easy. Choosing each other when things were difficult. Choosing each other when life seemed determined to test us over and over again.

And somehow, despite everything, we are here.

Today marks two years since the day I was lucky enough to call you mine, and even now, after everything we have been through, I still find myself looking at you with the same feeling I had when I first realized how much you meant to me.

Maybe even more.

Because loving someone at the beginning is easy. Everything is exciting. Everything feels new. Everything feels light.

But loving someone after seeing their fears, their pain, their insecurities, their grief, their anger, their struggles, and their imperfections... And still choosing them? That is a different kind of love.

And that is the kind of love I feel for you.

Frinzez, there are so many things I wish I could tell you, and I don't know if words will ever be enough.

But if there's one thing I want you to understand today, it is this: Thank you.

Thank you for staying. Thank you for choosing me when I wasn't always easy to love. Thank you for seeing something in me worth fighting for, even during the moments when I couldn't see it myself.

Thank you for every time you believed in me. Thank you for every conversation, every laugh, every memory, every lesson, every sacrifice, and every moment you've shared with me.

You have changed my life in ways I will never fully be able to explain.

Before you, I thought life was something you simply survived. Then you came along and showed me that life is something you share.

You showed me that happiness feels different when there's someone you want to tell everything to. You showed me that achievements mean more when you have someone celebrating beside you. You showed me that even ordinary days can become special when they're spent with the right person.

You became one of the greatest blessings God has ever placed in my life. And I know I don't say that enough.

The truth is, you helped shape the man I am today. You challenged me. You supported me. You encouraged me. You pushed me to become better. You made me realize my worth when I struggled to see it. You made me believe that I was capable of being loved.

These last two years haven't been perfect. We've had our arguments. We've hurt each other. We've misunderstood each other. There were times when we both felt exhausted. Times when we questioned ourselves.

But every single challenge taught me something. It taught me that love isn't just about the good days. It's about choosing someone on the difficult days too.

And love, we've had difficult days. We've had nights where we went to sleep hurting. We've had conversations that left both of us crying. We've had moments where we felt far apart even when we were talking.

Yet somehow, every time, we found our way back to each other. And that means something. Because people don't keep trying this hard for someone they don't love.

You are worth it. You always have been.

This past year especially has been incredibly heavy for you. I watched you carry grief that no one should ever have to carry. I watched you lose your Papa. I watched you struggle through pain that I could never completely take away. And now, I've watched you lose your Lola too.

The same Lola you loved deeply. The same Lola you cared for. The same Lola you stayed beside. The same Lola whose comfort became one of your biggest priorities.

Love, I know there are days when you question yourself. Days when guilt tries to convince you that you could have done more. Days when your heart replays memories over and over.

But I hope you know this: Your Lola knew. She knew you loved her. She knew you cared. She knew you stayed. She knew you were there. And that matters.

You gave her your time. Your effort. Your presence. Your love. You became one of the people who made her final chapter brighter. And nobody can take that away from you.

I know you're hurting. I know there are moments when you feel lost. But please never forget how much love you gave. Because she knew. And because of that, I know she left this world carrying that love with her.

I am proud of you. Not just because of how strong you've been. But because of how loving you've been. Even when life kept hurting you, you continued to love people. That takes a special kind of strength.

I'm proud of everything you're building for yourself. Your perfume business. Your goals. Your dreams. The future you're trying to create. I know how much effort goes into it. I know how many worries you carry. I know how badly you want to succeed.

And I want you to know that I believe in you. Completely. Even during the moments when you doubt yourself. I believe in you. Because I've seen what you're capable of.

Love, I also need to say something else today. I'm sorry. I'm sorry for every time I made your burdens heavier. I'm sorry for every promise I struggled to fulfill. I'm sorry for every moment I wasn't the man you needed me to be.

You deserved better than those moments. And while I cannot change the past, I promise you that I am still trying to grow. Still trying to learn. Still trying to become better. Because you are worth becoming better for.

As we enter another year together, I don't want to promise perfection. Life has already taught us that perfection doesn't exist. But I can promise effort. I can promise honesty. I can promise commitment. I can promise that I will continue choosing you.

Again. And again. And again. No matter how many miles separate us. No matter how difficult things become. No matter how long this distance lasts.

Because distance has never changed how I feel about you. If anything, it has made me appreciate you more. It has shown me how much of my life is connected to you. How much I miss your presence. How much I miss hearing your voice. How much I miss seeing your smile.

And despite all of that... I am still here. Because my love for you was never dependent on convenience. It was always dependent on you. The person. The woman. The heart that I fell in love with.

So today, on our second anniversary, I want to leave you with this:

If life gave me the chance to go back two years and start all over again... Knowing every fight. Every misunderstanding. Every tear. Every challenge. Every goodbye. Every difficult night. And every beautiful moment in between...

I would still choose you. Without hesitation. Without doubt. Without regret.

Because loving you has been one of the greatest privileges of my life. And because no matter where life takes us from here... You will always have a home in my heart.

forever yours Drew
